noun denoting the meeting or confluence
noun denoting the place or seat

items.question: Which auspicious union, abode, and practice have been declared and received by the seeker?
premises: The abode has been heard by the seeker.
The desired practice is characterized as auspicious.
items.inference: The seeker has received the teaching concerning the auspicious union, abode, and practice.
uncertainties: The precise sense of melakaṃ as a physical meeting-place or a mystical union is context-dependent.
ceṣṭitaṃ may refer to desired conduct or to an enacted practice.
items.plain_english: The union has been declared, the abode has been heard by you, and the desired practice is auspicious.
